item.title: 11 Gardaí allocated to Northwestern region from 167 newly sworn officers
item.description: Eleven new Gardaí have been allocated to the northwestern region, which includes the Galway Division, from a class of 167. item.title: Missing Galway teen found safe and well
item.description: A teenage girl reported missing from Kilconly earlier this week has been found safe and well. item.description: Galway County Council has established a new committee to coordinate the delivery of sustainable outdoor amenities across County Galway, including trails, parks and water-based infrastructure. item.title: Plankton hold the secrets of the ocean in their shells
item.description: An international research team led by the University of Galway has found a new way to learn about ocean acidity and CO2 levels using plankton.
